intelligence.essence: Shawn's order: at the bottom of the Hub, the PLUS button has two choices in one menu — TOP = add a post (a dropdown to select which world it goes to); SECOND = create a world (create a space / create a thing, on any topic). Create-a-world runs the SAME 15-question walkthrough (motto, goal, vision, etc.) and the answers create that page with its URL, editable after. That is how pages are created.
